plugins.description: An autonomous solo-TTRPG dungeon master engine for Vaults of Vaarn. Bundles the MCP engine (~50 tools: combat, vault maps, travel, NPCs, canon tracking, history search), seven skills (/vaarn-start onboarding, /session-start, /session-end, /menu, location generation), the DM output style, narrative-quality hooks, a companion terminal dashboard, and the Vaarn rules data (CC BY 4.0, by Leo Hunt).
